records.public_claim_text: He underscored that, without any significant improvement in its working methods, the mandate of the Committee and the interaction of civil society with the United Nations would be damaged.

records.public_claim_text: He emphasized that, in seeking consultative status with the United Nations through the Council, NGOs aimed to share their expertise and insight and provided specific ideas on how certain issues could be tackled at the international level.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: He emphasized that, in seeking consultative status with the United Nations through the Council, NGOs aimed to share their expertise and insight and provided specific ideas on how certain issues could be tackled at the international level.

records.public_claim_text: He underscored that the Committee’s role was crucial to facilitating and improving that cooperation and stressed that Türkiye continued to support the active participation of NGOs in the work of the Council and its subsidiary bodies, as well as in international conferences organized by the United Nations, in conformity with the spirit, purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations, as well as the framework set out by the Council in its resolution 1996/31.

records.public_claim_text: With that understanding, he reiterated that the role and competence of the Committee, as the primary specialized United Nations body to consider consultative status applications, should not be undermined.

records.public_claim_text: He stressed that the Committee should be able to maintain its regular working method of reviewing each application on a case-by-case basis.

records.public_claim_text: He noted that, during the Committee’s resumed session in 2023, the vast majority of Committee members had voted against recommending consultative status on all individual applications that had been put to a vote.

records.public_claim_text: She reiterated that, in 2022 and 2023, the United States had been proud to present for a vote at the Economic and Social Council several groups of organizations who had been targeted for political reasons and whose accreditation had been deferred for far too long.

records.public_claim_text: Welcoming the facilitation by the Secretariat of a long-overdue Committee consultation with civil society organizations in 2022, she said that it was regrettable that such consultations had not been continued in 2023.

records.public_claim_text: She called upon the Committee to facilitate regular consultations ahead of each January and May session, as mandated by the Council in its resolution 1996/31.
